newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: AVERAGE GROSS SALARY IN MAY ROSE TO 795 LITAS.
newsitem.headline: AVERAGE GROSS SALARY IN MAY ROSE TO 795 LITAS.

text.p: Lithuania's statistics department said on Wednesday that the average gross salary in May rose to 795 litas from 751 litas in April.
The department also said in a statement that the average gross salary in the country's public sector rose to 824 litas in May from 779 litas in April.
The average gross salary in the private sector amounted to 750 litas compared to 706 litas the month before, the statement added.
The department said that the minimum living standard in May was 110 litas and minimum monthly earnings stood at 400 litas.
It added that the minimum hourly wage was 2.36 litas in May versus 1.95 litas in April.
